purpose: Stage-disjoint stochastic evidence registry for the prospective recoverability battery.

calibration_WB.reuse: same bank across all 16 physical cells as CRN; method outcomes forbidden

confirmation_WB.reuse: same fresh bank across all 16 physical cells as CRN; selected queries fixed before use

M1_M2_common_bank.rule: reuse across M1 and all 27 M2 joint variants and across physical cells as CRN

M3.rule: rank r uses seed_base+(r-1)*stride+k for k=0..N_r-1; rank streams independent; same rank streams may be reused across physical cells as CRN

LHS_MSE_TOP1_DIAG.seed_rule: reuse exactly the first 100 seeds of M3 rank-1 stream: seed_base + k, k=0..99
LHS_MSE_TOP1_DIAG.comparator_rule: KL Top1 diagnostic uses the same first 100 rows of the production M3 rank-1 ledger

final_whitebox.reuse: same bank across all eligible physical cells as CRN; one physical ledger reused across each cell's 15 queries
final_whitebox.embargo: must not be generated/read before the battery-level global prediction-freeze manifest covers every eligible physical cell

deterministic_algorithm_rng.note: Algorithmic RNG controls are not stochastic evidence banks. They remain fixed to preserve the pilot algorithms.

engineering_smoke.rule: throwaway seeds outside every scientific range; smoke outputs must never be read by scientific stages
